card.name: Plural ending of drug-class acronyms
card.fires_on: The final "As" in plural drug-class acronyms such as TCAs (tricyclic antidepressants) and NMBAs (neuromuscular blockers). It fires after the acronym stem in drug-interaction text.

modes.label: TCAs
modes.description: The "As" ending of TCAs, the acronym for tricyclic antidepressants, in interaction lists.

modes.label: NMBAs
modes.description: The "As" ending of NMBAs, the acronym for neuromuscular blocking agents.
